label: Title and DOI of the references of pathways with few references
description: Pathways with at most two references, with the title and DOI of each reference from Wikidata (through QLever). Returns 10 pathways at a time (LIMIT and OFFSET).
query:
PREFIX biopax:  <http://www.biopax.org/release/biopax-level3.owl#>
PREFIX cito:    <http://purl.org/spar/cito/>
PREFIX dc:      <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX freq:    <http://purl.org/cld/freq/>
PREFIX gpml:    <http://vocabularies.wikipathways.org/gpml#>
PREFIX owl:     <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX pav:     <http://purl.org/pav/>
PREFIX prov:    <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdf:     <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX void:    <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
PREFIX wp:      <http://vocabularies.wikipathways.org/wp#>
PREFIX wprdf:   <http://rdf.wikipathways.org/>
PREFIX xsd:     <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX pmw:		<http://rdf-plantmetwiki.bioinformatics.nl/pathways/>
PREFIX ncbi:    <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCBITaxon_>
PREFIX ro:		<http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_> 
PREFIX bioregistry: <https://bioregistry.io/mibig:> 

#Federated prefixes:
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wdtn: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct-normalized/> 

SELECT DISTINCT ?pwID ?title ?nPublications ?paperTitle ?pubmedWD ?DOI ?wd
WHERE {  
  {
  
  SELECT ?pwID ?title ?pubmedWD (COUNT(DISTINCT ?pubmed) AS ?nPublications)
    WHERE {
  		?pw a wp:Pathway ;                #Define pathways
      		dc:title ?title ;             #Define pathway titles
      		dc:identifier ?pwID ;         #Define pathway IDs
      		(dcterms:references|cito:cites) ?pubmed .  #Collect total references for pathways
      
        ?pw (dcterms:references|cito:cites) ?pubmedWD .  #Keep PMIDs for downstream analysis
      
        }
    GROUP BY ?pwID ?title ?pubmedWD                   #Results need to be aggregated to apply count
    HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?pubmed) <= 2)             #Retrieve pathways with a few publication
    LIMIT 10                                          #To avoid timeouts
    OFFSET 10                                         #To retrieve item 101-200, can be used in a script to collect data from all entries
    }
  
      BIND(STR(?pubmedWD) AS ?pubmedStr)
      BIND(STRAFTER(?pubmedStr, "https://identifiers.org/pubmed/") AS ?pmid0raw)
      
SERVICE <https://qlever.cs.uni-freiburg.de/api/wikidata> {
  ?wd wdt:P698 ?pmid0raw .                           #Connect PMID from pathways to Wikidata entries
      OPTIONAL{ ?wd wdtn:P356 ?DOI ;                 #If there is a DOI, extract
      wdt:P1476 ?paperTitle . }                      #If there is a title, extract
}
}
ORDER BY DESC (?nPublications) ?title
